provided.name: SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider
provided.transaction: read-only validation in caller UnitOfWork; no nested receipt/commit
provided.rule: Disappearance validation proves one exact pending sr_source_disappearance_review population_absence proposal and its prior accepted canonical SR observation. Reappearance validation proves one exact conflict-free canonical SR observation in the exact published advanced_search_sr run. Neither method accepts source field values or mutates proposal/domain state.

provided.name: RfcSourceEvidenceProvider
provided.rule: has_accepted_source_provenance is read-only and uses one exact source-provenance predicate for stable RFC hard-delete preview snapshots and current writer read contexts; validation/source-freshness methods retain their existing command-time authority

provided.name: ReconciliationProposalEvidenceProvider
provided.transaction: read-only validation in caller UnitOfWork; no receipt/commit
provided.rule: Validates exact currently pending Advanced Search SR reference proposals inside the outer AcceptReconciliationProposal UnitOfWork. validate_sr_customer_acceptance requires the single encoded customer_org_id identity change. validate_sr_contact_acceptance requires reference_role customer_contact -> sr_contact_reconciliation or current_handler_reference -> sr_current_handler_reconciliation, exactly one encoded contact_id identity change, the exact proposal source_observation_field_id and command/proposal bindings. The provider does not transition proposal state or decide LLD-03 current reference/source eligibility; LLD-03 revalidates owner state and LLD-04 performs the accepted disposition after owner/participant writes in the same UnitOfWork.

consumed.name: WfmImportReader
consumed.rule: RETIRED Task Nos are immutable LLD-05 nonreuse authority and must never be treated as ABSENT/create-or-adopt candidates. activity_conflicts is used only for reviewed same-lineage competing-attempt evidence under the exact LLD-05 provider contract; overlap by itself never chooses or implies an activity-lineage decision.

consumed.name: WfmActivityReviewParticipant
consumed.rule: Used only by the dedicated reviewed wfm_competing_attempt_review resolution path after LLD-04 has revalidated the exact pending proposal and current LLD-05 conflict fingerprint. LLD-04 never derives decision from overlap/source labels and never writes LLD-05 lineage tables directly.

rules: LLD-04 owns source evidence/proposals only; owner-domain writes cross only these interfaces and never use nested receipts/commits.

RfcSourceEvidenceProvider.has_accepted_source_provenance is a read-only cross-packet reader so LLD-03 can use one stable snapshot for hard-delete preview and the same predicate under commit-time writer revalidation.

Advanced Search source-presence warning history is LLD-03 authority. LLD-04 validates absence/reappearance evidence through SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider and uses bounded durable reappearance reconciliation after successful publication; source presence never accepts a source field value or mutates ticket lifecycle.

WFM proposal generation must classify Task No through LLD-05 before create/adopt: RETIRED produces a blocked identity finding and no mutation proposal, ACTIVE resolves current identity, ABSENT alone may enter create/adopt review.

wfm_competing_attempt_review is review evidence, not an inferred lineage mutation: generic AcceptReconciliationProposal cannot accept it. Its dedicated resolver carries the operator's explicit LLD-05 decision/review fingerprint and uses WfmActivityReviewParticipant in the same outer UoW before LLD-04 records the accepted disposition.
ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant is invoked by LLD-03 and is not a direct LLD-04 mutation dependency.
